changelog.3: seniority_fit: neutralize 'member of technical staff' / 'member, technical staff' before tier matching so the rank-neutral MTS title (Vapi/OpenAI/Perplexity, etc.) no longer false-matches the 'staff' tier-0 pattern; falls through to seniority_default (12) unless another explicit signal (e.g. 'senior') is present. No weight changes.
changelog.4: Score up fintech / applied-AI-in-finance, business/finance-degree-friendly postings, and genuinely early-grad/new-grad roles: category_bonus.fintech 7 -> 10 (now the top vertical, tied with ai-infra/fde-solutions territory); new degree_language_bonus (+6, keyword hit on finance/business-degree-friendly language); new early_grad_bonus (+6, keyword hit on new-grad/early-career language). Old score rows are preserved; this is a version bump, not a rewrite.
changelog.5: company_signal stopped silently zeroing out the 269 auto-discovered/auto-promoted companies (category_bonus has no entry for those category strings, so they fell to base=0 instead of the neutral midpoint the missing-row case already gets): auto-discovered/auto-promoted rows with why_fit still NULL now get the same neutral_midpoint (5/10) as an unseeded company, via new auto_categories. Added score_inferred_vertical: title/description keyword match on fintech (payments, trading, banking, capital markets, crypto, custody) or ai-infra (ai agent, agentic, llm, forward deployed, applied ai — bare 'agent' dropped after the read-only projection caught it false-firing on 'Agent Experience' courier-ops titles) language awards the same points as the metadata category_bonus path, combined via max() (never additive) so curated companies can't double-dip and unknown/auto companies aren't capped below a textually-obvious vertical fit. Nothing in scoring reads posted_at (verified by grep) — no recency component exists or was added; workday/builtin's structural NULL posted_at was already a non-issue for scoring.
changelog.6: seniority_fit now treats the title as authoritative rank evidence and separately parses explicit candidate experience requirements. Incidental description words such as senior/staff no longer suppress early-career roles; conflicting early-career titles with 3+ year requirements use the explicit requirement. Each score stores the exact seniority evidence for auditability. Added explicit adjacent target-title coverage for deployment strategist, customer engineer, technical operator, and AI GTM roles.
changelog.8: v8 — finance x AI hybrid postings (the candidate's stated #1 preference) were scoring below the tier-1 cutoff even when company_signal was already maxed via the fintech category_bonus/inferred_vertical (that path caps at 10 and can't credit domain depth in the posting text itself). Added finance_hybrid_bonus (+10, applies once): keyword hit on finance-domain depth language — payments/tax/wealth/trading/banking-infrastructure context, 'finance degree', GTM-engineering-at-fintech, and applied-AI-in-finance phrasing — distinct from degree_language_bonus (credits degree-major openness, not domain content) and from company_signal's already-capped vertical credit. Purely additive on top of the existing 5-component + 2-bonus total (still clamped to 100); no existing components, weights, or stored v7 score rows were changed. (v7 itself — adding 'junior' to early_grad_bonus keywords — shipped without its own changelog entry.)
